setup.zh: 从淮水往南，过了江，是震泽。《禹贡》说三江既入，震泽底定——如今湖水涨了三年，三条江都倒着流。一个打鱼的女人在浅滩上拣东西，拣起来的不是鱼，是骨头，一节比她的船还长。
setup.en: South from the Huai and over the Jiang lies Zhenze. The Yu Gong says: the three rivers entered, and Zhenze was stilled. Now the lake has been rising for three years, and all three rivers run backward. A fisherwoman is picking things out of the shallows — not fish but bones, one joint longer than her boat.

recap.zh: 过江到了震泽：湖水涨了三年，三江倒流，浅滩里尽是大骨头。
recap.en: Over the Jiang to Zhenze: the lake had risen for three years, the three rivers ran backward, and the shallows were full of great bones.

text.zh: 水往回走。第五鼎在南边，它在往自己那儿收水。
text.en: The water is running back. The fifth cauldron is to the south, drawing the water to itself.

alone.zh: 水往回走。第五鼎在南边，正把水往自己那儿收。
alone.en: The water runs back. The fifth cauldron lies south and is drawing the water to itself.

text.zh: 打鱼的女人说：夜里有个大个子从湖里走过去，一步一个浪。要问，去姑苏。
text.en: The fisherwoman says: at night a giant wades across the lake, a wave at every step. Ask in Gusu.

exits.means: goes to the town, to Gusu, to ask about the giant

text.zh: 你沿着湖往东走。姑苏的阊门外船挤着船，门上贴着告示。
text.en: East along the lake. Outside Gusu's Chang Gate the boats jostle, and a notice hangs on the gate.

exits.means: looks at the bones, asks the fisherwoman about them

text.zh: 骨头一节就有一辆车长。女人说，吴兵当年拆会稽城，也挖出过这样一节，没人认得，派人去问了孔子。
text.en: One joint of it is as long as a cart. The woman says that when Wu's soldiers razed Kuaiji long ago they dug up a joint like this; no one knew it, and they sent to ask Confucius.

text.zh: 孔子认得。……走吧，别让他等太久。
text.en: Confucius knew. …Come, let's not keep him waiting too long.

exits.means: wades into the lake, tries to go straight south across the water

text.zh: 你往湖里走了十步，水就涨到了胸口，一个浪把你推了回来。
text.en: Ten steps into the lake the water is at your chest, and a wave pushes you back.
The water is rising. Gusu first.

alone.en: The water is rising. Gusu lies east.
